metaIgLongLivedExchangedAt.comment: Set when the short-lived Instagram Login token was exchanged for a long-lived one via graph.instagram.com/access_token. Used by ChatwootInboxIntegration to skip re-exchange on re-activation.

connectionStatus.comment: Real-time, validity-based connection status. Unlike hasAccessToken (mere token presence), this reflects whether the token is actually usable. Computed at read time by ConnectionStatus loaders: local-only in list views, live provider health-check on detail view.
